thread:
lina: Quick check — planning to flip the 'soft-scale-gradient' flag to 10% canary today at 15:00 UTC. Expected window ~2h. Can we confirm audiences, guardrails, and rollback criteria?

tried to summarize below, please reply with +1 or concerns.

lina: Proposed audience: 10% of inbound traffic across eu-west and us-west; exclude internal orgs and known heavy-batch customers.

tom: +1. Do we have an override to exclude a specific customer id if needed?

sasha: yes — runtime supports a skiplist via 'flag_exclude_ids'. I pushed a tiny patch to make it hot-reloadable.

priya: Guardrails to watch: p95 inference latency, queue depth, and error rate. Suggest thresholds: p95 < 220ms, queue depth < 40, errors < 0.6%. If any of these hit for 5m continuous, auto-rollback.

dave: +1 on metrics, also watch 'burst_throttle_retries' and 'concurrency_spikes'. If retries spike > 1% we should pause.

lina: Good call. I'll add those to the rollout policy. Quick config snippet for ops reference:

```
flag: soft-scale-gradient
audience: 10% (eu-west, us-west)
exclusions: ['internal-*', 'partner-123']
guardrails:
  p95_latency_ms: 220
  queue_depth: 40
  error_rate_pct: 0.6
  throttle_retry_pct: 1.0
rollback: auto after 5m sustained breach
monitoring: grafana+alert -> #eng-oncall, pager if severity high
window: 2h
```

tom: Do we need to coordinate with Dedicated capacity teams for the burst window? Might see some allocation shifts.

lina: Reached out to @david (dedicated infra) earlier — he said capacity buffer of 10% is available. Still tagging @eng-oncall to be on watch.

eng-oncall: will be on standby for the window. Please post the final rollout command here before flip.

sasha: Also added a quick smoke test in the canary job: 50 synthetic requests across short and long sequences. If the smoke fails, rollout aborts.

priya: +1. One more ask — can we enable request sampling at 5% for golden-set evals? Need to track qualitative regressions.

lina: yes — adding sampling flag to the canary.

deploy-bot: CI passed for branch feat/soft-scale-gradient. Canary job scheduled at 2026-03-17T15:00:00Z.

dave: I'll keep an eye on dashboards during the first 30m, ping here for any anomalies.

tom: pinging infra on rotation. If anyone needs to pull the audience down mid-run, call it out and I can flip back to 0% immediately.

lina: thanks all. Final checklist: audience confirmed, guardrails set, smoke tests enabled, eng-oncall + infra on standby, sampling enabled. I'll execute the flip at 15:00 UTC and post the rollout command here.

(ended with a short thumbs-up thread emoji reaction summary)
